description: This file defines an interface for writing and managing payment detail data within the Fineract platform. It declares methods to create and persist payment details based on commands and changes, facilitating interactions with payment detail domain objects.

classes.name: PaymentDetailWritePlatformService
classes.description: An interface that specifies the contract for creating and persisting payment details in the platform.

methods.name: createAndPersistPaymentDetail
methods.description: Creates a new payment detail from the provided command and changes map, then persists it.

methods.name: createPaymentDetail
methods.description: Creates a new payment detail object based on the command and changes, without necessarily persisting.

methods.name: persistPaymentDetail
methods.description: Persists the given PaymentDetail object into storage.
